profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer @ Tenstorrent
profile.summary:
Excellent programmer with a knack for low-level coding and a passion for problem-solving.
Specifically interested in compilers, operating systems, and high-performance computing.
Jesus lover. People lover. Music Lover.

The University of Alabama

The University of Alabama
Minor: Electrical Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked on BLAS implementation for a proprietary accelerator, exploring hardware-specific optimizations before the project was discontinued.

- Created simulator for host-side of RISC-V accelerator chip using QEMU

-Built RISC-V embedded linux system to boot on simulated host cores using Buildroot

- Implement bus interface and device emulators for device-side of emulated RISC-V accelerator chip, enabling full boot emulation

- Integrate x86 QEMU emulator with custom RISC-V chip emulator over simulated PCIE interface, facilitating full device emulation

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented a query compiler and optimization engine from the ground up with over 20 optimization passes
- Created a comprehensive error-checking frontend for the Cypher query language
- Implemented relational and graph-based query operators for a distributed query engine
- Augmented parallelization in query engine using MPI and thread primitives resulting in over 10x performance gains
- Mastered C++ data structure, metaprogramming, and object-oriented design

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching Assistant for CS 470/570 - Algorithms

Create thought-provoking and challenging questions for quizzes and tests.
